title: 70s Green Room
text: All right, Kenny, we have to make sure everything is perfect for Fleona's show tonight. My job is on the line. I have 14 strikes against me, and it's a 15-strike system. Sounds complicated. Well, she's very particular. Oh, I've heard. Everyone's heard about Fleona. Well, shut up! Here she comes now. Go. Maurice, you have got to get us a new tour bus driver. He tried to tell me about his family. I'm sorry, Fleona. That's the last snafu of the night, I promise. Well, good, because I'm gonna be doing all my moves tonight. The seat belt, the funky turtle, the reach-around. Yes! So everything has got to be perfect, and, damn it, I'm hungry. Well, Mama, it's all good, because I sent them your rider weeks ago, and they got every snack on your list. Good. So they got my yellow M&Ms? No, they do not. What? Well, did they get my danishes? No. My big pizzas? No. Little pizzas? No. Shasta? No shasta. Sanka? No sanka. Cold cuts? No. Hot chops? No. Baby carrots? No. Grown carrots? No. What about my tuna twist? None! Well, I know they got my big, heavy snacks. Sandwich, but the ham is cubed. Fleona, none of the food is here, Fleona! Well, what do they have? This tiny, dry salad. Undressed? Damn it, Maurice. I can't have a repeat of Tucson. They forgot my shasta and my vocal cords. I remember, Fleona. You know what? Let's get you into hair and makeup while I make this right. Maxine is here. She's all set up. Yep. I got everything on the list Maurice sent me. Everything? Everything. So you got the afro sheen? Don't got it. Curl sticks? No. Curl cream? Nuh-uh. Buggy pins? Nope. Shiny for lip? No way. Shiny for eye? No how. Shiny for cheekbone? Never. Okay Vaseline? Forgot. Aquanet? Forget. L-net? That's what. Baskera? No, ma'am. Parfum? I'll give you one guess. Well, what did you bring, girl? A little brush? Damn it, Maxine. Slap Maurice. Oh! Maurice, this is feeling like Tucson all over again. And you know I wasn't nominated for a disco Grammy this year. I know, Fleona. Will you feel better if you smack me again? Yes. Ooh! Ah! Ooh! Hey, is this a bad time? I heard people are getting smacked in here. Fleona, this is Mickey and Marty. They're the band for tonight. It's an honor to meet you, Miss Fleona. We're huge fans of yours. Good, so you must know all my songs, right? Oh yeah, every one of them. Disco Twilight? Nope. Hot Pants Charlie? Nope. Nasty Christmas? No. What about Beep, Beep, Hey, Hey, Who's That, It's Me? No. Beep, Beep, Hey, Hey, Oh Look, It's Sharice? That one sounds familiar, but no. Maurice, you are this close to strike 15. Well, you know what? Let's just set up and we'll teach the songs. Mickey, you brought the xylophone, right? You know I didn't. Metronome? You know I won't. Gramophone? That's an old-timey record player. Flute? I play bass. Flute. I play bass. Did we do? What's that? Hurdy-gurdy. You making fun of me? Theremin. If you get a cut on your leg, put some theremin on it. Kalimba. Who? Liar. No, you are. Maracas. Absolutely not. Just regular drums. Yeah, I got those. Well, great. Where are they? I got bass and two amps. Damn it, Maurice. Ooh. Thank you, baby. No problem. Wait, Fleona. You know what? You don't need all this stuff. Everything you need is inside of you, baby. You've got it. You mean I got talent? Yes. Style? Yes. Pretty arms? Yes. And an ass higher than Mount Kilimanjaro? Oh, yes. Okay, boys. Then let's disco do this gig. Fleona, baby. You got to get out there and do your thing. Anyone who's anyone is in the crowd tonight. Who? Lil' Jimmy? Yeah. Jimmy's here. Who? Who? Who? Really? What about Cletus Jones? No. John Wayne Brady? No. Mrs. Perkins? No. Pastor Chris? No. Rabbi Shmuley? No. Fleona? No. See, that's me. I tricked you. Oh.
